events.content:
Implemented the notification toggle in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx) and added its Server Action in [app/actions.ts](/workspace/app/actions.ts).

The preference is stored in an HTTP-only cookie, defaulting to off. Submitting the form toggles it, then calls `refresh()` from `next/cache` so the current page shows the updated preference without redirecting. This is browser-specific persistence; the app has no database or user authentication configured.

I didn’t run tests.
